_about: Site Docs rules. Every document type, lead time, renewal link and trade pack lives here, not in Swift. Guidance only: always check the official site.

rag._note: Red: expired or 14 days or less left. Amber: inside the renewal lead time or 60 days or less. Green: otherwise.

types.label: CSCS card
types._validityNote: Most CSCS cards last 5 years. Some (such as trainee or provisional cards) are shorter. Check yours.
types._leadNote: Renewing usually needs a Health, Safety and Environment test passed in the last 2 years, and tests can be booked up weeks ahead. Check the CSCS site for the earliest you can renew.
renewSteps: Check which card you need. It may have changed since last time.
Book and pass the Health, Safety and Environment test if yours is more than 2 years old.
Apply to renew on the CSCS website or by phone.
Keep your old card until the new one arrives.
types.note: Many sites will not let you through the gate without an in-date card.

types.label: CBT certificate
types._validityNote: A CBT certificate lasts 2 years. Pass your full test in that time, or take CBT again.
types._leadNote: Training slots can book up weeks ahead.
renewSteps: Book a new CBT course with an approved training school, or book your full test.
Take your driving licence to the course.
Keep the new DL196 certificate safe. You may be asked for it.
types.note: Riding on an expired CBT can mean you are not insured.

types.label: MOT certificate
types._leadNote: You can get an MOT up to a month (minus a day) before it runs out and keep the same renewal date.
renewSteps: Book an MOT at a local test centre.
Do it up to a month (minus a day) early to keep the same renewal date.
Check the result on GOV.UK afterwards.
types.note: Driving without a valid MOT can lead to a fine and can affect your insurance.

types.label: Vehicle insurance
types._leadNote: Quotes are often cheaper about 3 to 4 weeks before renewal.
renewSteps: Get quotes about 3 to 4 weeks before it ends.
Check the cover fits your work, such as hire and reward or business use.
Save the new certificate in the app.
types.note: Using the vehicle for work often needs business, courier or hire and reward cover.

types.label: PHV driver licence
types._validityNote: TfL private hire driver licences usually last 3 years. Other councils may differ.
types._leadNote: Apply early. Checks such as DBS and medicals take time. Check your licensing authority for its own advice.
renewSteps: Start your renewal online with your licensing authority (TfL in London).
Get a tax check code from HMRC. You will need it to renew.
Book any medical, DBS or other checks they ask for.
Keep proof that you applied in case your licence runs out while you wait.
types.note: Outside London, your council licenses you. Change the renewal link to your council's page.

types.label: PHV vehicle licence
types._validityNote: TfL private hire vehicle licences usually last 1 year. Other councils may differ.
types._leadNote: Conservative value: inspections need booking. Needs checking against your authority's advice.
renewSteps: Apply to renew the vehicle licence with your licensing authority.
Book the vehicle inspection.
Check your MOT and insurance are in date first.
types.note: Outside London, your council licenses the vehicle. Change the renewal link to your council's page.

types.label: DBS certificate
types._validityNote: DBS certificates have no official expiry date. Many employers ask for one under 3 years old. Change the date to what your employer wants.
types._leadNote: Conservative value: checks can take several weeks.
renewSteps: Ask your employer or agency which check they need.
If you use the DBS Update Service, renew your subscription each year.
If not, your employer or agency starts a new check for you.
types.note: The Update Service lets employers check your certificate is still current, with your permission.

types.label: SIA licence
types._validityNote: Most front-line SIA licences last 3 years.
types._leadNote: The SIA says you can apply to renew 4 months before your licence expires.
renewSteps: Sign in to your SIA online account.
Apply to renew. You can do this 4 months before it expires.
Check if you need any top-up training first.
Wear your current licence until the new one arrives, if it is still in date.
types.note: Working without a valid licence is an offence.

types.label: First aid certificate
types._validityNote: First Aid at Work and Emergency First Aid at Work certificates usually last 3 years.
types._leadNote: Book the requalification course before it runs out.
renewSteps: Book a requalification course before it runs out.
Check with your employer which course they need (FAW or EFAW).
Scan the new certificate when you get it.
types.note: HSE also recommends a yearly refresher.

types.label: Driving licence
types._validityNote: The photocard needs renewing every 10 years. The date is at 4b on the card.
types._leadNote: Conservative value: renewing online is usually quick, but post can take weeks.
renewSteps: Renew online on GOV.UK. You need a passport or a photo.
Pay the fee shown on GOV.UK.
Send back your old photocard when asked.
types.note: You can be fined if you do not renew your photocard.

types.label: Right to work share code
types._validityNote: A share code for proving your right to work lasts 90 days. Get a new one for each new job.
renewSteps: Sign in to view and prove your immigration status on GOV.UK.
Choose to prove your right to work and get a new share code.
Send the code and your date of birth to your new employer or agency.
types.note: Your eVisa itself may have a different end date. Check it on GOV.UK.

types.label: Other document
renewSteps: Check who issued it and how to renew.
Add their renewal page as the link for this document.
